records.text: Candace Owens said Senator Mike Lee had been scheduled to attend Charlie Kirk's September 10 event at Utah Valley University but canceled early that week because of National Defense Authorization Act votes in Washington.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now turning point USA, of course, was aware that Senator Lee (Mike Lee) was going to attend. But as the D.C. story goes, that week the senator had to cancel very early on in the week due to the National Defense Authorization Act.

verification.notes: Live research confirmed that the Senate was considering the FY2026 NDAA on September 10, 2025, and that Mike Lee was participating in Senate business that week. However, no public event listing, Lee-office statement, TPUSA record, or other authoritative source located in the search established that Lee had been scheduled for the UVU event or that he canceled specifically because of NDAA votes. The surrounding facts are plausible, but the key scheduling and cancellation assertions remain unverified.
